title: Zebra improves node and wallet infrastructure
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
BUILD
02
Zebra improves node and wallet infrastructure
August engineering / releases and merged work
ZCASH FOUNDATION
ZEBRA + FROST
01
Zebra 6.3.0
Released August 10, with sync, peer-handling and node-reporting improvements.
02
Direct wallet serving
ZF merged an initial lightwalletd-compatible server into Zebra; the feature
remains disabled by default.
03
Operator migration
An operator guide documents the move from zcashd to Zebra through the
compatibility sidecar.
04
FROST
frost-tools gained support for signing Ironwood shielded transactions.

title: Crosslink tooling moves through public testing
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
BUILD
03
Crosslink tooling moves through public testing
Feature-network work / no mainnet activation
SHIELDED LABS
CROSSLINK + PRIVACY
01
Zero-indexer
Shielded Labs, Caution, Zec.rocks and Stardust prepared zero-indexer
deployment and wallet integration. Testbed stage.
02
Crosslink workshop
The August 26 workshop covered feature-network updates, hard-fork tooling and
nightly-network plans.
03
Community dashboard
An independent finalizer and delegator dashboard appeared August 29. It shows
one node, not the whole network.

text:

Tachyon adopts shared cryptography
August research development
PROJECT TACHYON
PROTOCOL RESEARCH
01
Common adoption
The August 29 Common announcement records Tachyon adopting the shared
cryptography stack.
02
Protocol status
The proposed scalability upgrade remains research work; no production activation
is established by these sources.

title: Zakura 1.3.0 moves to Common
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
BUILD
05
Zakura 1.3.0 moves to Common
Released August 31 / full-node software
ZAKURA
NODES + CRYPTOGRAPHY
01
Block and transaction processing
The new release uses Common for shielded cryptography, with improvements for
node operators and miners.
02
Experimental consensus
The new P2Pv2 consensus engine is experimental and disabled by default on
Mainnet.
03
Reusable cryptography
Common was introduced August 29 as an open stack for nodes and wallets. Its
use requires no network upgrade.

title: The supporting stack expands
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
BUILD
08
The supporting stack expands
Sync, indexing and developer test networks
ZODL Slipstream
Slipstream shipped with ZODL 3.9.0; the August 12
announcement describes faster wallet restoration and sync.
Zaino
Zaino released 0.7.0 on August 5, 0.8.0 on August 19 and
0.9.0 on August 29.
ZSA testnet
An independent public ZSA network opened for testing on
August 2, separate from regular Zcash Testnet.
Zinder
Zinder was introduced August 19 with a native query
protocol and lightwalletd-compatible runtime.

title: New products broaden ZEC use cases
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
PRODUCTS
09
New products broaden ZEC use cases
August introductions and reported development / maturity varies
0xramp
Introduced August 27: non-custodial ZEC access through
local-fiat payment rails.
Konclave
Introduced August 27: FROST group vaults; a first Zcash
Brazil treasury use case was reported in August.
Free2Z
August 25 update: renewed development and mobile testing,
with login-with-Zcash and encrypted chat still in progress.
RadioZec + GameHub
Brazil reported initial RadioZec deployment and a GameHub
trivia deployment used at Blockchain.RIO.

title: August highlights
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
HIGHLIGHTS
10
August highlights
Delivered work and the next layer of detail
Faster, more reliable infrastructure
Zebra, Zakura, Zaino and Slipstream advanced node operation, wallet
serving and synchronization.
Four core wallets shipped
The month brought stable releases across ZODL, Zingo, Vizor and
Zkool, with platform-specific improvements.
Privacy tools reached new stages
0xramp and Konclave were introduced; Free2Z reported renewed
development and Brazil tested new community tools.
